app.name: AutoLaya
app.tagline: One-stop automated domain decision modeling solution

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: One project is one domain and one decision Schema.
projects.domainPlaceholder: Describe the domain, users, and decisions
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project, its Schema, seeds, samples, and dataset snapshots?
projects.noProjects: Create your first project to start building your decision model.

schema.title: Decision Schema
schema.subtitle: Define typed questions. The same Schema drives generation, review, and export.
schema.noQuestions: Add at least one Choice, Noul, or Score question.
schema.keyHint: Letters, digits, and underscores. Example: team
schema.scoreLabelsHint: Comma-separated labels from low to high, e.g. can wait, this week, today
schema.noulHint: Noul is a yes/no probability. No options are needed.
schema.deleteConfirm: Delete this question and its annotations?
schema.cannotChangeType: Answers already exist. Duplicate the question instead of changing its type.

seeds.title: Seed examples
seeds.subtitle: Anchor generation with a few realistic states. Labels are optional but improve review.
seeds.labelsHint: Map question keys to answers. Example: {"team": "billing"}

samples.title: Samples
samples.subtitle: Every generated, imported, or manual state that is waiting for review.
samples.noSamples: No samples yet. Add a seed or a manual sample.
samples.heldoutHint: Held-out samples are always written to the test split.

datasets.title: Dataset snapshots
datasets.subtitle: Freeze accepted samples into immutable Canonical, Laya, and GLiNER files.
datasets.freezeHint: Only accepted samples with answers for every question are included.
datasets.deleteConfirm: Delete snapshot v{{version}}? Its training/evaluation history will also be removed. Model artifacts are kept.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Human review is the final authority. Accept, edit, or reject every sample.
review.selectSample: Select a sample from the queue.
review.noPending: No pending samples. The queue is clear.
review.missingAnswers: Every question needs an answer before the sample can be accepted.
review.noulHint: Probability between 0 and 1. Values ≥ 0.5 export as yes.
review.acceptedHint: Accepted samples are included in the next dataset snapshot.
review.batchPartial: Some samples could not be updated

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime configuration and local deployment details.
settings.warning: Keys are read only from backend/.env. They are never sent to the browser.
settings.phase: Generation, Jev teacher labeling, Laya fit/fine-tune, evaluation, and local serving are available. Install the Laya runtime with ./deploy.sh setup-laya.
settings.layaSetupHint: Run ./deploy.sh setup-laya to install torch and laya[serve].
settings.guideHint: Replay the full walkthrough from Schema design to training completion.
settings.runtimeHint: Current device, runtimes, and local data location.
settings.hardwareHint: Devices available for training and inference.
settings.noGpu: No dedicated GPU detected. Using CPU, or the driver is not installed.
settings.gpuDetailsUnavailable: A {{backend}} device was detected, but detailed hardware information is unavailable.

generate.title: Generate data
generate.subtitle: Generate domain states with the LLM, then label them with Jev or leave them for human review.
generate.jevMissing: Jev is not configured. Choose “No teacher” or add a teacher key to backend/.env.
generate.llmMissing: LLM_API_KEY is not configured in backend/.env.
generate.runningHint: Generation and teacher labeling can take a while. You can keep working while it runs.
generate.llmLabelHint: The LLM writes weak labels together with each sample. They still go through human review and are marked teacher=llm.
generate.percentHint: Drag the dividers; the total stays at 100%.
generate.thinkBudgetHint: Sent as reasoning.max_tokens; only works with providers that support it. Leave blank for the default.
generate.temperatureHint: Leave blank to use backend LLM_TEMPERATURE.
generate.customPromptPlaceholder: For example: prefer short tickets, include negations, avoid templated phrasing…
generate.customPromptHint: Appended to the generation instructions; it cannot change the JSON output shape or Schema.
generate.previewHint: The preview uses the current settings, the first language, and one batch.
generate.thinkLevelHint: Sent as reasoning_effort; leave blank for the provider default.
generate.systemPromptPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default System Prompt. Placeholders below are available.
generate.userPromptPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default User Prompt. Placeholders below are available.
generate.promptTemplateHint: A custom template fully replaces the default content. Placeholders expand to the current project, Schema, seeds, difficulty, and sampling values. Use default_system / default_user to reuse default content; custom_prompt maps to “Append custom prompt”.
generate.customTemplateHint: Off uses the built-in templates. Turn on to edit System and User Prompts.

train.title: Train Laya
train.subtitle: Fit calibration heads or fine-tune a Laya checkpoint on a frozen snapshot.
train.runtimeHint: Run ./deploy.sh setup-laya on this machine, then refresh.
train.fitHint: Fast: a small head per question over frozen features, then calibration.
train.finetuneHint: Full gradient fine-tune with laya-train. GPU recommended.
train.glinerHint: Fine-tune GLiNER2 classification heads on the reserved GLiNER JSONL export.
train.chartNoData: This training run has no chartable metrics.

evaluate.title: Evaluate
evaluate.subtitle: Compare Jev, official base models, and this project’s trained fit/fine-tuned artifacts on held-out rows.
evaluate.question: Question
evaluate.missingArtifact: Run a fit or fine-tune job first to evaluate that model.
evaluate.confidenceOnly: Probability metrics are approximate: GLiNER exposes a label and confidence, not full class probabilities.
evaluate.groupRemoteHint: Jev called through its API; not a locally trained model.
evaluate.groupBaseHint: Official base checkpoints, not fine-tuned with this project’s data.
evaluate.groupTrainedHint: Latest fit calibration or fine-tuned artifact from this project; older versions are not selected automatically.
evaluate.legacyNoMetadata: Legacy run did not store model metadata
evaluate.historyHint: Pick the artifact version to evaluate. The latest version is used by default.

models.title: Models & deployments
models.subtitle: Registered Laya artifacts and local Jev-compatible serving processes.
models.noArtifacts: No model artifacts yet. Train or fit Laya first.
models.portHint: Leave port blank to allocate automatically.

welcome.title: From a domain problem to a usable decision model
welcome.desc: AutoLaya turns a business description into a locally deployable Laya or GLiNER model. Learn the loop first, then follow it in your project.

schema.title: Create a project and define the decision Schema
schema.desc: One project maps to one domain. Define Choice, Noul, and Score questions. Clear option descriptions keep generation and labeling consistent.

seeds.title: Add seed examples
seeds.desc: Anchor the domain language with a few real inputs. Add seeds manually or download a JSONL/CSV template and upload them in bulk.

generate.title: Generate training data
generate.desc: Set sample count, languages, teacher, and difficulty mix. The job shows progress and can be paused, resumed, or cancelled.

review.title: Review and correct samples
review.desc: Inspect each input and teacher answer, fill missing answers, then accept or reject. Only accepted, complete samples enter the dataset.

dataset.title: Freeze a dataset snapshot
dataset.desc: Turn accepted samples into an immutable version and download Canonical, Laya, or GLiNER JSONL.

training.title: Choose a model and start training
training.desc: Pick the exact Laya or GLiNER base, snapshot, device, and training parameters. Progress and logs update live.

done.title: Training complete: evaluate and deploy
done.desc: Training registers a model artifact. Deployment is the required next step; you can optionally compare Base, Fit, and fine-tuned models on the evaluation page before deploying the chosen artifact as a local API.

mock.domain: SaaS support tickets; decide the team and urgency
mock.ticket: I was charged twice this month, please refund the duplicate charge.
mock.teamQuestion: Which team should handle this ticket?
mock.urgentQuestion: Does this ticket need attention today?
mock.schemaHint: Tip: keep one domain per project; use lowercase English keys such as team and urgent.
mock.seedHint: Labels are optional; labeled seeds still need human confirmation after being sent to review.
mock.datasetHint: Contains only accepted samples with an answer for every question

onboarding.welcomeHint: New here? Click “New project”, then follow the same workflow through Schema, data, training, and deployment.
onboarding.mockNote1: All content here is a mock demo; real projects are untouched.
onboarding.mockNote2: Numbered markers show key actions or click targets.

intro.desc: Turn domain requirements into a deployable decision model in one local workspace.
intro.time: Build your own fine-tuned Laya model in under 30 minutes

playground.title: Playground
playground.subtitle: Freely test base and trained models, edit the Schema/state, and export a SystemOne cURL.
playground.hint: Choose a project and model, enter a state JSON object, then run. The first model load may take a while.
playground.loadHint: The first model load can take 10–60 seconds.
playground.schemaHint: Use the project Schema, a preset, or build questions entirely from scratch.
playground.empty: Run a test to see an answer for every question.
playground.missing: The model did not return an answer for this question
playground.runtimeMissing: The selected model runtime is not ready.
playground.questionsHint: Questions are fully editable; both runs and exports use the current editor content.
playground.invalidQuestion: Every question needs a unique, non-empty key.
playground.missingOptions: Choice questions need at least one option.
playground.missingScoreLabels: Score questions need at least one ordered label.
playground.curlHint: Fill in the BaseURL and model name (placeholders are allowed) to generate the complete /v1/systemone request body.
playground.requestModelHint: Written only to the exported cURL; it does not change the local inference model.
playground.curlEmpty: Fill in the content, then click “Generate cURL”.

sandwich.question: Is a hamburger a sandwich?
sandwich.state: A hamburger is a patty with toppings served inside a sliced bun.
sandwich.true: A hand-held food made by filling bread or a bun.
sandwich.false: A food that does not fit the sandwich definition.

sky.question: What color is the sky?
sky.state: On a clear day, the sky looks blue.

urgency.question: How urgent is the situation described?
urgency.state: Production is down and every customer is unable to log in.

mixedExample.state: Customer report: I was charged twice this month. I contacted support twice, but the refund still has not arrived.

noul.question: Is this a billing or refund issue?
noul.true: It involves a refund, duplicate charge, billing, or payment.
noul.false: It is unrelated to billing, refunds, or payments.

choice.question: Which team should handle this ticket?
choice.billing: Refunds, duplicate charges, billing, and payments.

score.question: How quickly should this ticket be handled?

playground.baseUrlHint: /v1/systemone is appended automatically; use a local service URL or a placeholder.
